name: RunWay token lets anyone burn inflated sell volume from its pair
summary: RunWayERC20 (BYC) adds the full amount of every fee-taking transfer into its USDT pair to lpBurnFrequency, even when the tokens are immediately swapped back out. Its public autoBurnLiquidity() then moves lpBurnFrequency tokens from the pair to 0xdead and calls sync(). In the transaction right after the owner's launch(), the attacker bought 698,539 BYC with flash-loaned USDT, sent them back to the pair and recovered them with a second swap, then called autoBurnLiquidity(). That left the pair's BYC reserve near zero, and one sale drained its 119,950.5 USDT.
notes: Owner launch() set startTradeBlock from 0 to 44534603, one transaction before the exploit in the same block. While it was 0, _transfer required a fee-whitelisted party for every pair transfer, so the non-whitelisted, fee-taking transfer that inflates lpBurnFrequency was unreachable. The flawed runtime has been unchanged since deployment.

Exact USDT depletion of the BYC/USDT PancakeSwap pair 0x2942dfd0bf9e704348cdb16333443025ecbd8639, which fell from 119950.5 USDT to 2 wei in the exploit. Flash-loan principal and fee are circular attacker flows. The attacker netted 105363.04 USDT, of which it swapped 3000 for BNB.
